name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Table Tag Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, featuring a single wooden layer with 5mm thickness for durability and stability.
    - Smoothly cut and polished edges with a wood grain finish.
    - Consists of 2 pre-cut wooden pieces designed to fit together securely make the base.
    - Lightweight yet sturdy construction, suitable for tabletop display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 6 x 9 inches ~ 15.24 x 22.86 cm.
    - Base width: 1.18 x 6 inches ~ 3 x 15.24 cm.
    - Custom shape designed for balanced and stable standing.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality printing technology for clear, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Features double-sided printing for a polished and complete look from all angles.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a freestanding wooden table tag sign for desks, shelves, counters, or display tables.
    - Easy to assemble by interlocking the two pre-cut wooden pieces.
    - Perfect for use as name signs, decorative accents, or seasonal tabletop décor.
    - Functions as both a personalized keepsake and a minimalist décor piece.
    📌 Note: Customers can easily assemble the product by interlocking the pre-cut wooden pieces. No tools required.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and personalized gift for moms, teachers, friends, family members, and loved ones.
    - Ideal for Mother’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarmings, and special events.
    - A charming keepsake that adds warmth and personality to any space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Table Tag Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
